startingRecipe: Continue flight-course second ordinary flight at physics entry, stop96. Capture 16 input-return checkpoints at 0e0c:02b3 while holding Space and scheduling Down at native frame70..100. Continue to firstTile>=21 for scene pair; request Up to trigger the balloon release. See docs/flight.md.

rules.level: Sixteen-frame closed-loop routine segment with independent consumption-boundary input stream; three conditional scene-state and three pixel comparisons. Not an independent full-flight runtime or browser acceptance.
rules.comparison: Exact bytes of game state written by translated physics, scene, objects and supported collision paths. Whole 320x200 RGBA PNGs, without tolerance or excluded pixels.
conditions: Starting memory is captured internal state at original flight physics entry; no later expected memory is used as an input.
Input codes originate at the return of original input provider 1124:0002, before main 02b3 stores them. They are recorded separately from expected states.
Conditional scene comparisons use independently captured entry memory and actual plane argument on the original stack.
Sprite data and fonts come from hash-verified original PLANE.ARC and MAIN.ARC.

The final checkpoint is before applying the newly returned control value. Only the fifteen controls between the sixteen checkpoints belong to this replay; every required control has a subsequent observed output. The sixteen-record raw capture is retained locally as flight-loop-inputs-captured.json.
exclusions: Stack, software-FPU workspace, CPU registers other than capture identity, hardware/driver fields, timer state and original CPU processing latency.
Sound requests and analog output are not compared.
The closed-loop segment stops at input consumption checkpoints; it does not validate meaningful wall-clock timing or full flight/campaign outcomes.
Sprite fetches beyond declared strips stop strictly and are not substituted. Special flight animations, final arrival and campaign consequences are not covered.
